text: Completed checked indexed-run and selection bridge. DatasetRun is now a private checked zero-copy view over one DatasetTimeBlock; mismatched direct keys fail, multi-run FmriDataset values expand through DatasetIndex.fromDataset with shared underlying dataset identity, run descriptors expose block-local frame/shape/axis, and run-local time selections translate to global series indices plus DatasetRunPartition local/global coordinates. DatasetIndex.single is checked and cross-run coordinate preparation requires exact NeuroSpace grids and readable membership. Added VoxelSelection.Coords using existing VoxelCoord/Indexing and mask-domain validation, plus TimepointSelection.Window with positive-length/overflow/bounds checks and overlap support. Tests cover mismatch, zero-copy expansion, local/global mapping, coordinates/order/out-of-grid/mask, exact-grid cross-run rejection, and window overlap/empty/out-of-range. Gates passed: datasetJVM 71, datasetJS 45; final JVM/JS compile warning-clean; relevant diff check clean.
